svg.title: fig. 51 — Everything is one step from a bank
svg.text: 553 firms in the sector · 3,709 one step out · 1,534 two
520 firms in the sector · 2,882 one step out · 2,240 two

g.text: one, two or three steps out

The 6,011 firms of the interlock graph, placed by how many steps they sit from a sector's boards: the sector at the centre, one band per step. Radii come from cumulative firm counts — area is proportional to the

number of firms — so the blue line falls where the share of the network reachable in one step ends. Finance on the left (553 firms), mining on the right (520), almost exactly the same size: 70.9% of the network against
56.6%. Same result as the removal tests, in geometry. The edges are a sample of centre-to-first-band ties (900 of 79,636) and are there as texture only.
